subject: reasoning
question:
Select the cube which can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1504add9278612705cef6805cb010f29569de2225928f62973d830ab65ec099.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d8c64e3ba2a4b8cff467bc86a654dfc665831d346f0b548c7c704ae139f5999.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4ba172ca189a66d95c576468650bca92ac332db6b6ebe7eba36528ca0edcb96.png] 

⇒ As the alternate position becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, the opposite pairs are:

 
• 1 → 3
 
• 2 → 4
 
• 5 → 6

Therefore, according to the question :

 
• The given figure A → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50c4b2a17111d9cfad787a28c5b37669874c32ffe89a0a0a0b427ebae7ac912e.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 5 and 6 are one of the opposite pairs)
 
• The given figure B → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ef10463da18bd8facd7041d2e9137330675476cad97b58f0eab188033865e9e.png] ⇒ Cannot be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 5 and 6 are one of the opposite pairs)
 
• The given figure C → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c5be525c042daec95c32fcb20436441ce2c9ff53f25cf3cb042be71225f8b2.png] ⇒ **c****an be formed **as a cube from the given sheet (As 2, 3 and 6 are one numbers of each opposite pairs)
 
• The given figure D → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05198a5c28877f67f5799c0078714d68cf81f40ddd5ad7ad5eb2733047fd5460.png] ⇒ Can be formed as a cube from the given sheet (As 1, 4 and 6 are one numbers of each opposite pairs)

​Here, Only figure C and D can be formed as a cube from the given sheet.

Hence, "Only C and D" is the correct answer.
